snippet.title: The Abbess Garden | Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Get The Abbess Garden now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3411970/The_Abbess_Garden/ 

Cozy third-person gardening in 1643 France. As Agnès, restore a forbidden abbey garden, grow and identify real plants through the seasons, uncover a spy plot, help the community, and find romance.
